performance.verdict: Organic-only account; GBP collapse is the sole active revenue risk.

findings.text: Zero paid spend and zero leads across all 28 days — no paid channel is active, so CPL and ROAS are structurally undefined for this account.
GBP actions collapsed 89.47% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 18-20) show 0 actions vs avg ~3/day in prior 3 days (Aug 15-17), confirming a sharp stop, not a dip.
GA4 sessions dropped 20.75% week-over-week; last 3 days averaged 8.0 sessions vs prior 3-day avg of 9.7, a modest but consistent softening of organic site traffic.
28-day GA4 records 184 sessions and 149 users but 0 conversions — the website is receiving organic visitors with no tracked lead outcome, suggesting a broken or absent conversion event.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP profile immediately: check for suspension, ownership issues, or removed hours causing 0 actions for 3 straight days.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for the last 3 consecutive days (Aug 18–20) after averaging ~3/day in the prior week — an 89.47% weekly collapse. Log into Google Business Profile today to confirm the listing is live, not suspended, and that phone/hours/address are intact. Success is defined as GBP daily actions returning to ≥2/day within 7 days of the fix. Re-check by 2026-08-28.

suggestions.text: Verify and repair GA4 conversion event: 184 sessions with 0 tracked conversions over 28 days indicates a broken lead-capture event.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded 184 sessions and 149 users over the last 28 days but logged exactly 0 conversion events — no leads are being captured in analytics even if the form is functioning. Check GA4 tag firing in Tag Manager against the contact/enquiry form thank-you trigger. Success is at least 1 confirmed conversion event firing in GA4 debug view before 2026-08-28.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 session trend: 3-day avg dropped to 8.0 from 9.7 — re-check after GBP fix to see if organic traffic recovers.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions softened 20.75% week-over-week, with the last 3-day average at 8.0 vs 9.7 the prior 3 days. No action yet; re-check sessions on 2026-08-28 after GBP is restored — if sessions have not recovered to ≥10/day average by then, escalate to organic SEO review.
